blocks.text: Smart contracts aise digital muahide (agreements) hain jo khaas sharait poori hone par un mein likhi shartein khud ba khud poori kar dete hain. Yeh contracts blockchain technology par chalte hain, is liye darmiyani (intermediaries) ki zaroorat khatam ho jati hai aur ghalti aur dhoke ka khatra kam hota hai.

Ethereum jaise platforms developers ko smart contracts se decentralized applications (DApps) banane dete hain. Yeh contracts bohat se shobon mein kaam aate hain, jaise finance, supply chain management, real estate (jaidad) aur insurance (beema). Maslan insurance ka smart contract pehle se tay sharait ke mutabiq flight late hone par khud ba khud raqam ada kar sakta hai.

Smart contracts ke faide: transparency (shaffafiyat), kyunke tamam fareeq contract ki shartein dekh sakte hain; aur security, kyunke contract ka chalna blockchain yaqeeni banata hai. Lekin in ke kuch masail bhi hain, jaise code bilkul be-ghalti hona chahiye, aur in contracts ke jhagron ko hal karne ke liye qanooni nizam (legal systems) bhi chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 ke hawale se smart contract kya hai (exercise MCQ 18)? Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contracts kya hain (exercise short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Aisa khud chalne wala (self-executing) contract jis ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain. Jab code mein likhi sharait poori hon, maslan adaigi mil jaye aur milkiyat ki tasdeeq ho jaye, to contract kisi darmiyani ke baghair khud chal jata hai.

items: Smart contracts: blockchain par khud chalne wale digital muahide.
Ethereum par DApps; finance, supply chain, real estate, insurance (flight late ki misal).
Faide: transparency, security; masail: be-ghalti code aur qanooni nizam ki zaroorat.
